entities.name: Error handling procedures
entities.description: Procedures for handling unknown, unforeseen, and erroneous protocol data by the receiving entity. They provide recovery mechanisms for error situations and define a compatibility mechanism for future protocol extensions.

entities.name: Mandatory for UE
entities.description: Most error handling procedures are mandatory for the UE to implement.

entities.name: Network implementation dependent
entities.description: Detailed error handling procedures in the network are implementation dependent and may vary from PLMN to PLMN.

entities.name: Error thresholds not reached
entities.description: Network error handling is only considered mandatory or strongly recommended when certain error thresholds are not reached during a dedicated connection.

entities.name: Compatibility mechanism
entities.description: Error handling procedures define a compatibility mechanism for future extensions of the protocols.

relations.description: Error handling procedures are mandatory for the UE.
Network implementation of error handling procedures is dependent on PLMN.
Network error handling requirements are conditional on error thresholds not being reached.
Error handling procedures establish a compatibility mechanism for future protocol extensions.
